thread:
lina: Quick ask for launch collateral — need a reproducible smoke pack from runtime for the benchmark section of the blog. Small, auditable, no-cherry-pick set we can show in a screenshot.

lina: Request list (short):
- Warmup profile: 5rps -> 200rps over 6m using poisson jitter, hold 200rps for 8m, total ~8k requests. Capture p50/p90/p99 and time-series.
- Coldstart matrix: 3k single-shot requests across fresh replicas, produce heatmap by latency buckets.
- Quant variants: fp16, q4_k_m, q5_1 (if q5_1 OOMs, note fallback).
- Long-context tail: 10k token prompts (50 samples) both with cold KV cache and warm KV cache.
- Streaming vs non-streaming micro-comparison (15 samples).
- Include sample payload manifest + md5 and exact run commands for provenance.

sam: Clarify model -> use "redwood-x-7b-lr" (the one in the product page). OK to use marketing_cohort_v3 for sampling?

lina: Yes use marketing_cohort_v3. Pull random seed 42 for reproducibility and include sample IDs.

jess: For outputs, product wants: warmup_time_series.csv, coldstart_heatmap.png, quant_variant_report.csv, long_context_breakdown.csv, samples_manifest.json, runbook.txt. Also want a small PNG we can paste in the blog (single-panel warmup curve).

faisal: We'll run on pool-3. Plan: schedule three jobs (warmup, coldstart, quant/long-context). Will attach run metadata + md5 to s3://internal-bench/marketing/1766001234/.

lina: Embargo: hold until launch week. Mark any provisional runs as EXPERIMENTAL in the manifest.

faisal: Example curl we will include (token redacted):

```
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDACTED" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-x-7b-lr","input":"<sample>","max_tokens":512,"stream":false,"cache_kv":false}'
```

faisal: ETA for full artifacts 18-30h. If you need an internal preview PNG sooner I can run a 1k-request warmup preview and drop warmup_preview.png by EOD.

jess: Preview would be great for copy review. Please tag @jess and @lina when uploaded.

faisal: Will do. Run ids: job-warmup-99888, job-cold-99889, job-quant-99890. Logs + artifacts at https://internal.redwood/bench/runs/99888 and s3://internal-bench/marketing/1766001234/.

runtime-bot: job-warmup-99888 queued on pool-3 (expected runtime ~2h), job-cold-99889 queued, job-quant-99890 queued. Notifying participants on completion.

lina: Thanks — call out any quant regressions or OOMs in the manifest with the fallback used. Also include md5 of samples_manifest.json for audit.

faisal: Copy, will post final manifest + artifacts here when ready (or error if something breaks).
